verdict.rationale: Capacities documents itself as an offline-first app: changes sync when you reconnect, media can be downloaded for offline viewing, and search works offline on all devices. Ownership comes only through its own export feature, including scheduled automatic full exports to human- and machine-readable Markdown with front matter and CSV. Nothing shows the primary store is local files you can read without the app, so the exports are snapshots rather than the live store. Missing for 10: notes stored natively as local files or an openly readable local store, evidence that every feature works fully offline, independent or hands-on corroboration of offline behavior.
